args.body: Take the existing CATALOGUE-EXISTING-BUYER-PAID-ACCEPTANCE-CHECK under a valid lease. Read its saved scope before acting. Use only permitted aggregate or redacted operator evidence and the existing terms crosswalk. If an eligible inquiry and the relevant operator decisions are documented, prepare the case-specific acceptance handoff using the independently reviewed editor report if suitable. Otherwise record the precise missing evidence within the existing mission and keep the existing terms and item 4 decision artifacts. Read back any result before closure with a lesson. Keep inquiry, acceptance, delivery and Treasury settlement distinct.

description: The independent catalogue rehearsal recorded the expected duplicate-image failure and 12 passing checks after the edit. That supports finishing the editor handoff for an eligible inquiry. Aggregate feedback shows zero classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. The order register is unavailable and Treasury reports CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Paid acceptance depends on an eligible inquiry, approved terms and administrative acceptance. A redacted operator receipt or attributable inquiry would advance that path. The SQLite window is due on November 22 at 00:00 UTC and can be evaluated independently.
